messages:
maya: Heads-up — noticed a recurring 'ledger echo' causing duplicate token entries for a small subset of customers. Quick snapshot, not a full postmortem yet.

maya: sample investigative query I ran: ```select account_id, sequence_id, count(*) as cnt from ledger_events where created_at > now() - interval '7 days' group by account_id, sequence_id having cnt > 1```

julia: confirmed, saw this in billing runs last Wed/Thu — ~120 accounts had duplicated token rows, leading to inflated invoice usage. :grimacing:

chen: initial hypothesis: reprocessing job retries are writing without an idempotency key. I'm digging into reprocess_worker logs and write path.

maya: quick proposed action list (owners + rough ETA):
- chen: add/validate idempotency on reprocess write path (owner, ETA 72h)
- mike: draft credits runbook + compute net deltas for affected accounts (owner, ETA 48h)
- julia: implement a fast detector job that scans last 72h for duplicate (account,sequence_id) and alerts (owner, ETA 1w)
- ops-bot: schedule a canary reprocess and dry-run (owner, ETA scheduled)

mike: I'll own the credits playbook. Plan: export affected accounts, compute token delta per invoice period, issue credits, and add a note in invoices. Will aim to have CSV + draft credit entries by EOD Thu.

julia: detection approach: lightweight SQL job that runs hourly; flag >1 rows for same (account,sequence_id). I'll open a PR with tests by Friday morning.

chen: here's a log excerpt that looks relevant: ```reprocess_worker.py: attempt=3 job_id=abcd write_status=ok duplicate_detected=false``` — the write says duplicate_detected=false but downstream shows duplicate rows. suspect the duplicate flag isn't reliable.

ops-bot: canary scheduled: 2024-06-20T09:00:00Z (will run against staging subset first).

maya: @sarah can you coordinate comms with CS for impacted customers? We'll hold messaging until credits list is finalized but want to prep templates.

sarah: will draft an email/SAP ticket template and queue it. prefer waiting for final numbers before outreach.

mike: small question: for existing invoices should we prefer issuing invoice re-issues or simply apply credits? Accounting preference historically is credits unless legal change required. tagging accounting for signoff.

julia: agree on credits for speed and lower friction. escalate if a customer requests a reissued invoice.

maya: cadence: owners post daily async updates in this thread. Weekly roundup to PM and finance lead. If any blocker, ping for an ad-hoc call.

chen: starting the code changes now, will attach debug logs to ticket INF-1234 once I have timeline.

mike: creating playbook doc and checklist: https://docs.redwood.com/playbooks/billing/ledger-echo-remediation — will link the CSV and run commands there.

sarah: added comms owner and draft template to INF-1234.

maya: thanks all. Please drop short status notes here so we have a single source of truth. :thumbsup:
